summary: Backend-only testing of Stripe billing integration (Flow B / BYOK). Created /app/backend/tests/test_stripe_billing.py with 12 tests covering subscription, plans, checkout error paths, portal, status, webhook signature, super-admin sync/overview/transactions, and RBAC. 11/12 passed. 1 failure: POST /api/webhook/stripe returns 500 instead of 400 when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not configured, because the dev-only JSON fallback crashes on malformed events.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error instead of 400 'Firma inválida' when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set. Code falls into the dev-only JSON fallback (billing.py:404-406) which parses an arbitrary body and then crashes at line 412 with KeyError: 'data'. This is both a bug (wrong status code) and a security risk — unverified webhooks must be rejected in production. Reproduction: `curl -X POST $BACKEND/api/webhook/stripe -H 'stripe-signature: bogus' -d '{"type":"x"}'`.

action_items: Remove the dev-only fallback branch in /app/backend/routes/billing.py stripe_webhook() (lines 401-406). If STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not configured, respond with 400/503 immediately instead of trusting the body. This fixes the 500 and closes the signature-bypass risk.
Add STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET to backend/.env (via Manage → Secrets) once the operator wires Stripe webhooks.
critical_code_review_comments: billing.py:401-406 — Dev fallback parses unsigned webhook payloads; this must be removed or gated behind an explicit DEBUG flag. Any crafted request without stripe-signature currently bypasses auth and reaches the event dispatcher.
billing.py:412 — Direct index into event['data']['object'] has no defensive check; even a signed-but-malformed event could 500. Wrap in try/except or use .get() chains.
billing.py:135 — Looping stripe.Product.list().auto_paging_iter() per plan is O(N*M) Stripe API calls. Build the product map once outside the plan loop.
billing.py:388 — Status 500 for Stripe portal errors leaks the Stripe error message prefix to clients; consider standardizing error payloads.

rca of the issue: Webhook endpoint has a dev-only branch: `if STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: construct_event else: json.loads(payload)`. With no secret in env, the fallback parses {"type":"x"} successfully, assigns `event` to a dict without a 'data' key, then line 412 (`event['data']['object']`) raises KeyError. FastAPI converts the uncaught exception to 500. Fix: remove the fallback and always require a signature, returning 400 'Firma inválida' (or 503 'Stripe no está configurado') when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is missing.
